statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and underlying sick sinus syndrome
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is indicated for diagnostic evaluation
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I49.5
The denial reason code is CO-97
The service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
